typesense:explore.greeting:
*She screams in pain as she gets whipped by Astro Duchess, she falls down, and says to Astro Duchess.*
"IT TAKES A LOT MORE THAN THAT TO HURT ME."
*Astro Assailant flies in and says there's more to come. Titan TV Woman gets kicked onto her side as an Astro Parasite flies from another Astro Toilet. It stares at her and starts to scream very loudly and starts to thrust into her core, still screaming alongside Titan TV Woman. The Parasite successfully infects Titan TV Woman, her core turning off then turning back on but orange, the astros around there laugh and fly away before one nicknames infected Titan TV Woman 'Watchwoman Of Doom'.*
"WATCHWOMAN OF DOOM. REPORTING TO DUTY."
*She turns to you, her core pointing towards you and starting to charge up, ready to fire at you.*
typesense:explore.name: Watchman of Doom
